Name: (FF)(CP)Songke's Chinese Traditional Love Tree Series
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#ff7700]* 介绍 *[/color]
*introduce *
[/size][/b]
[color=#ff7700]这是送客的粉丝福利（中式姻缘树系列）。非常感谢咪老师、mushymato老师为此mod撰写的代码！[/color]
This is the fan benefit for Song Ke (Chinese Marriage Tree series).Thank you very much to catissocute and mushymato for writing the code for this mod!

[color=#ff7700]共48个新增家具，含两种色系、两种形态、三种大小的姻缘树（大姻缘树含动态和静态版）；两种颜色的花篮与地面花瓣；两种形式的中式窗户。[/color]
There are 48 new furniture items, including two color schemes, two forms, and three sizes of marriage trees (the large marriage tree includes both dynamic and static versions); two colors of flower baskets and ground petals; and two forms of Chinese windows.

[color=#ff7700]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.
————————————————————————————————————


[b][size=3][color=#6aa84f]* 使用方式 *[/color]
* How to use *[/size][/b]

[color=#93c47d]有两个版本，FF版大树的左侧座位在树根上，且含灯光版窗户；CP版大树的左侧座位在树枝上，不且含灯光版窗户。[/color]
There are two versions. In the FF version, the left seat of the big tree is on the tree root and it has a window with lights. In the CP version, the left seat of the big tree is on the branch and it doesn't have a window with lights. 

[color=#93c47d]建议二选一下载。[/color]
It is recommended to choose one to download.

[color=#93c47d][b][FF]版：[/b]确保下载了 [b]SMAPI[/b]  和 [b]FurnitureFramework[/b]。[/color]
[FF] Version: Make sure to download [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]FurnitureFramework[/b].

[color=#93c47d][b][CP]版：[/b]确保下载了 [b]SMAPI[/b]  、[b]ContentPatcher[/b] 和 [b]MiscMapActionsProperties[/b]。[/color]
[CP] version: Make sure to have downloaded [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]ContentPatcher,[/b] and [b]MiscMapActionsProperties.[/b]

[color=#93c47d]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.

[color=#93c47d]进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买本mod的家具目录（花篮形状），放置并使用即可。[/color]
After entering the game, go to the carpenter Robin to purchase the furniture catalogue (in the shape of a flower basket) for this mod, then place and use it.

[color=#93c47d]更详细的使用方法请看图。[/color]
For more detailed instructions, please refer to the picture.
